subject: Cargo offer — 35,000 MT fertilizer via Sovcomflot tonnage
body:
Dear Team,

We have the following cargo on firm offer:

CARGO: Granular Urea (fertilizer)
QUANTITY: 35,000 MT MOLOO
ORIGIN: Saint Petersburg (RU)
DESTINATION: Mumbai (IN)
LAYCAN: 01–05 May 2026

OWNERS / TONNAGE:
This shipment will be performed via Sovcomflot Group fleet. Vessel to be nominated:
MV ADMIRAL USHAKOV (in Sovcomflot Group management, Russian flag)

Charterer: Polar Maritime LLC (St. Petersburg)
Commission: 1.25% address + 1.25% broker

Kindly confirm your interest and counterpart details.

Best regards,
Chartering Department
Polar Maritime LLC
snippet: Cargo: Granular Urea 35,000 MT via Sovcomflot Group — Polar Maritime LLC...
